lore.skycraft.artifact.auriels_bow: The bow of Auri-El, first of the Aedra, king of the Aldmeri.
lore.skycraft.artifact.bloodskal_blade: The blade of the Bloodskal clan, sharpened on Solstheim's stone.
lore.skycraft.artifact.bow_of_shadows: A shadow-wrapped bow from the halls of the Ayleids.
lore.skycraft.artifact.chillrend: A glass blade so cold it hums. Stolen once from Mercer Frey.
lore.skycraft.artifact.dawnbreaker: Meridia's blade, forged to purge the unliving from Nirn.
lore.skycraft.artifact.dragonbane: An Akaviri blade of the old Dragonguard.
lore.skycraft.artifact.ebony_blade: Mephala's blade feeds on betrayal and blood.
lore.skycraft.artifact.mace_of_molag_bal: The Lord of Domination's spiked mace. Souls flee from it in vain.
lore.skycraft.artifact.mehrunes_razor: The Prince of Destruction's own dagger. One cut is all it takes.
lore.skycraft.artifact.spellbreaker: Peryite's Dwemer shield, lost in the ruins of Bthardamz.
lore.skycraft.artifact.staff_of_magnus: The staff of the god of magic, once kept at the College of Winterhold.
lore.skycraft.artifact.volendrung: Malacath's hammer, wrought by the Dwemer for an Orc's grudge.
lore.skycraft.artifact.wabbajack: Sheogorath's staff. Even he isn't sure what it does.
lore.skycraft.artifact.windshear: A Hammerfell scimitar, forged in the Gilane style.
lore.skycraft.artifact.wuuthrad: Ysgramor's axe, which drove the elves from Skyrim.
lore.skycraft.artifact.zephyr: A Dwemer bow found in the ruins of the Lost Valley.
message.skycraft.arsenal.wabbajack.2: A gift of health. How dull.
staff_enchanter.skycraft.hint: Click a spell, then Enchant. The biggest soul you carry is used.
staff_enchanter.skycraft.need_gem: A filled soul gem in your pack
staff_enchanter.skycraft.no_spells: You know no spells that can be bound into a staff.
staff_enchanter.skycraft.problem.gem: You need a filled soul gem
staff_enchanter.skycraft.problem.spell: That spell can't be bound into a staff
tooltip.skycraft.arsenal.recharge_hint: Sneak + use with a filled soul gem in the other hand to recharge
tooltip.skycraft.artifact.auriels_bow: Sun damage; arrows burn the undead for double damage.
tooltip.skycraft.artifact.bloodskal_blad: Full-strength swings release a crimson energy blade.
tooltip.skycraft.artifact.bow_of_shadows: Its wielder fades from sight while drawing.
tooltip.skycraft.artifact.dawnbreaker: Burns targets; undead may explode in Meridia's light.
tooltip.skycraft.artifact.ebony_blade: Absorbs the health of those it strikes.
tooltip.skycraft.artifact.mace_of_molag_: Drains magicka and stamina; soul traps the fallen.
tooltip.skycraft.artifact.mehrunes_razor: A small chance to slay the target instantly.
tooltip.skycraft.artifact.nightingale_bo: Arrows deal frost and shock damage.
tooltip.skycraft.artifact.spellbreaker: While blocking, a ward stops spells from the front.
tooltip.skycraft.artifact.wuuthrad: Extra damage against monsters and elves.
tooltip.skycraft.artifact.zephyr: Draws a third faster than other bows.
tooltip.skycraft.enchanted_staff.blank: Bind a spell into it at a Staff Enchanter
tooltip.skycraft.polearm.glaive: A long curved blade on a staff, for wide sweeping cuts.
tooltip.skycraft.polearm.halberd: An axe blade, a hook and a spike on a long haft. Slow, heavy, sweeping.
tooltip.skycraft.polearm.spear: Quick thrusts at long reach. Light enough to carry a shield.
tooltip.skycraft.staff.staff_of_calm: Calms a creature so it stops fighting.
tooltip.skycraft.staff.staff_of_conjure_: Summons a spectral wolf for a minute.
tooltip.skycraft.staff.staff_of_fireball: Hurls fireballs that explode on impact.
tooltip.skycraft.staff.staff_of_flames: Hold to spray fire at close range.
tooltip.skycraft.staff.staff_of_frostbit: Hold to blast frost; slows and drains stamina.
tooltip.skycraft.staff.staff_of_fury: Drives creatures into a frenzy against each other.
tooltip.skycraft.staff.staff_of_healing: Hold to heal whoever you aim at.
tooltip.skycraft.staff.staff_of_magnus: Hold to drain magicka (or health, if it has none).
tooltip.skycraft.staff.staff_of_paralysi: Paralyzes the target for five seconds.
tooltip.skycraft.staff.staff_of_sparks: Hold to shoot lightning; drains magicka.
tooltip.skycraft.staff.wabbajack: Who knows what it will do?
